article.story: EDWARDSVILLE, Ill. -- — David Douglas Jr.’s 18 points helped Northern Illinois defeat SIU-Edwardsville 68-65 in overtime on Wednesday. Douglas also had nine rebounds for the Huskies (5-3). Max Weisbrod scored 14 points while shooting 5 for 12, including 3 for 10 from beyond the arc, and added seven assists. Tyler King led the way for the Cougars (3-5) with 12 points. SIU-Edwardsville also got 12 points and two blocks from David Wilson. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
